question: Can Quillmarsh employees add a domestic partner to their health benefits?
answer: A domestic partner can be enrolled as a dependent on the medical, dental and vision plans.

sources.title: Quillmarsh Analytics - Retirement Savings Plan Overview
sources.text:
Quillmarsh Analytics offers a retirement savings plan to employees in the United States and a group registered retirement savings plan to employees in Canada.

US employees are enrolled automatically at a contribution rate of 4% of eligible pay 30 days after their start date, unless they choose a different rate or opt out. Quillmarsh matches 100% of the first 3% of pay you contribute and 50% of the next 2%, for a maximum company match of 4%. Company matching contributions vest after two years of service; your own contributions are always fully vested.

Canadian employees may contribute between 1% and 10% of base salary to the group plan. Quillmarsh matches contributions dollar for dollar up to 3% of base salary, and the match vests immediately.

You can change your contribution rate at any time in the benefits portal, and the change takes effect from the next pay period. Investment options include target-date funds, index funds and a stable value fund. If you do not make an investment choice, your contributions are placed in the target-date fund closest to the year in which you will turn 65.

Free one-to-one sessions with an independent financial planner are available twice a year to all employees, whether or not they contribute to the plan.

sources.title: Quillmarsh Analytics - Employee Assistance Program and Wellbeing
sources.text:
Every Quillmarsh employee, and every member of their household, can use the Employee Assistance Program free of charge. The program is run by an independent provider and is completely confidential: Quillmarsh receives only anonymous usage statistics.

Through the program you can access up to eight short-term counseling sessions per issue each year, by phone, video or in person. Counselors can help with stress, anxiety, grief, relationship difficulties and workplace concerns. The program also offers a free 30-minute consultation with an attorney or a financial coach on topics such as wills, debt or buying a home.

Quillmarsh also provides a wellbeing reimbursement of up to $300 per calendar year. It can be used for gym or fitness class memberships, sports equipment, meditation apps, or entry fees for races and other athletic events. Submit receipts through the expenses tool by 31 January of the following year; any amount you do not claim does not roll over.

Employees in both the US and Canada can also join the quarterly wellbeing challenges, which award small prizes and make donations to charity based on team participation.

sources.title: Quillmarsh Analytics - Benefits Guide: Who You Can Cover
sources.text:
Quillmarsh Analytics offers group health benefits to employees in the United States and Canada. Plan design differs between the two countries because Canadian employees also have provincial health coverage.

Employees scheduled to work at least 30 hours per week are eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage from their first day of employment. Part-time employees scheduled for fewer than 30 hours are eligible for the dental plan only.

You can cover your legal spouse and your children up to age 26, regardless of their student or marital status. For employees on the US payroll, a domestic partner can be enrolled as a dependent on the medical, dental and vision plans. Employees on the Canadian payroll should refer to the Canada Benefits Supplement, which applies the provincial definition of a common-law partner and has its own documentation requirements.

If a domestic partner is not your tax dependent, the value of their coverage is treated as imputed income and will appear as taxable income on your pay statement.

You can add or remove dependents only during open enrollment, which runs for three weeks every November, or within 31 days of a qualifying life event such as marriage, the birth or adoption of a child, or a dependent losing other coverage.

question: How long can Corrindale employees work from another country?
answer: Employees may work from a location outside their home country for up to 15 working days.

sources.title: Corrindale Robotics - Remote and Hybrid Working Guidelines
sources.text:
Corrindale Robotics is a hybrid employer. Unless your contract says otherwise, your role is attached to one of our three hubs, and you are expected to work there on Tuesdays and Thursdays. You may work the rest of the week from home or from another location in your home country.

Working from another country. Between 1 July and 31 August each year, employees may work from a location outside their home country for up to 15 working days. Outside that window, working from abroad is limited to 5 working days per calendar year and needs written approval from your director. Days spent abroad on approved business trips do not count toward either limit.

Before working abroad, submit a Remote Location Request at least ten working days in advance so that the Mobility team can check tax and immigration requirements. Some destinations cannot be approved for security or data-protection reasons; the current list is published on the Mobility intranet page.

Equipment and security. Company laptops may be taken abroad, but monitors, docking stations and other hub equipment must stay in the hub. Wherever you work, you must use a secure connection, and public Wi-Fi may only be used with the company VPN switched on.

Hub days may be swapped within the same week with your manager's agreement, for example to attend a customer visit on a Tuesday.

sources.title: Corrindale Robotics - Business Travel: Booking and Allowances
sources.text:
All business travel at Corrindale Robotics is booked through the company travel portal so that the Security team knows where employees are and can contact them in an emergency. Trips must be approved by your budget holder before anything is booked.

Rail is the default for journeys between our hubs in Leeds, Rotterdam and Porto wherever the scheduled journey time is under five hours. Flights are booked in economy class; premium economy may be booked for flights with a scheduled duration of more than eight hours.

While travelling on business you can claim a daily subsistence allowance to cover meals and incidental costs. The allowance is EUR 45 per day for trips within Europe and EUR 60 per day for trips elsewhere. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Hotel rooms are booked by the travel team within the nightly caps shown in the portal.

Business trips count as working time. Time spent travelling outside your normal hours can be taken back as time off in lieu within the following month, with your manager's agreement.

Claims for subsistence and other out-of-pocket travel costs must be submitted in the expenses system within 30 days of the end of the trip.

sources.title: Corrindale Robotics - Hub Facilities and Desk Booking
sources.text:
Each Corrindale hub is open from 07:00 to 20:00 on weekdays. Access outside these hours, including at weekends, must be arranged in advance with the hub facilities lead and is normally limited to lab work that cannot be scheduled during the day.

Desks are not assigned. Book a desk or a lab bench up to four weeks ahead in the Spaces app; bookings that are not checked in by 10:30 are released automatically so that colleagues can use them. Team zones are reserved on Tuesdays and Thursdays so that teams can sit together on their shared hub days.

Lockers are available on a first-come, first-served basis and must be emptied every Friday evening. Long-term storage for prototypes and test rigs is available in the Rotterdam and Porto hubs on request.

Every hub has quiet rooms, bookable meeting rooms and a kitchen with free coffee, tea and fruit. Lunch is subsidised in the Porto canteen, and in Leeds and Rotterdam employees receive a meal card that is topped up for every day they badge into the hub.

Visitors must be registered in the Spaces app by their host at least one day before their visit and must be accompanied at all times in lab areas.

question: What mileage rate does Sorrelwick pay for business journeys in a personal car?
answer: Colleagues who use their own car for business journeys will be reimbursed at 52 pence per mile from 1 April 2026.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Company Cards and Claim Approval
sources.text:
Colleagues who travel or buy goods for the business regularly may be issued a Sorrelwick company card. The card must only be used for business expenses allowed under this policy. Cash withdrawals are blocked, and any personal spending on the card must be repaid within 14 days.

Every transaction on a company card must be matched to a receipt and coded in the Expenses app by the end of the following month. If a receipt is lost, complete a missing receipt declaration; more than three declarations in any 12-month period will be reviewed by Finance.

Expense claims are approved by your line manager. Managers should check that each item has a business purpose, that the correct expense category has been used and that the amount is within the limits in this policy. Claims over GBP 500 also need approval from the budget holder.

Approved claims for out-of-pocket expenses are paid with the next monthly salary, provided they are approved by the 20th of the month. Claims approved after that date are paid the following month.

Misuse of a company card or the submission of a false claim is treated as gross misconduct under the disciplinary policy.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Expenses Policy: Overnight Stays and Meals
sources.text:
Colleagues who need to stay away from home overnight on business should book accommodation through the Sorrelwick travel desk, which has negotiated rates with hotels near our stores and distribution centres. If the travel desk cannot find a room within the nightly limit, it may approve a higher rate in advance.

The nightly limits for a room only are GBP 140 in London and GBP 95 elsewhere in the UK. Breakfast may be added if it is not included in the room rate.

When you are away overnight, you can claim the actual cost of an evening meal up to GBP 30, including one soft drink. Lunch can be claimed up to GBP 10 when a business journey takes you more than five miles from your usual place of work between 12:00 and 14:00. Alcohol is not reimbursed.

Personal items such as newspapers, toiletries, in-room films and laundry for stays of fewer than four nights are not reimbursable.

All claims for accommodation and meals must be submitted through the Expenses app with itemised receipts. Card payment slips on their own are not accepted as receipts.

sources.text:

Ordinary commuting between home and your usual place of work is not a business journey and cannot be claimed.

Colleagues who use their own car for business journeys will be reimbursed at 52 pence per mile from 1 April 2026, provided the journey is recorded in the mileage log within 30 days of travel. Journeys recorded after that deadline are not reimbursed. Journeys made before 1 April 2026 are reimbursed at the previous rate of 45 pence per mile. question: What is the annual learning budget for individual contributors at Halcyra Biotech?
answer: Individual contributors have an annual learning budget of EUR 1,500.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Learning and Development Budgets
sources.text:
Halcyra Biotech wants every employee to keep learning. Each division receives an annual learning and development budget, which can be used for courses, conferences, professional certifications, books and online learning subscriptions that relate to the employee's current role or agreed development plan.

Individual budgets in Research and Development. In the Research and Development division, individual contributors have an annual learning budget of EUR 1,500 and people managers have an annual learning budget of EUR 2,100. The higher amount for managers is intended to cover leadership training in addition to scientific development.

Other divisions. Budgets for Manufacturing, Quality, Commercial and Corporate Functions are set each January by the division head and published on that division's intranet page. They are not individual allowances, so employees should agree any spending with their manager before booking.

Budgets run with the calendar year. Unused budget does not carry over to the following year and cannot be transferred to a colleague.

Approval and payment. Requests up to EUR 500 can be approved by your manager. Requests above EUR 500, and any request involving travel outside the EU, also need approval from the division's learning partner. Wherever possible, the Learning team pays the provider directly so that you do not have to claim the cost back.

If an employee leaves Halcyra within 12 months of completing a course that cost more than EUR 2,000, they may be asked to repay part of the cost, as set out in the training agreement signed before booking.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Tuition Support for Degree Programmes
sources.text:
Tuition support is separate from the divisional learning and development budgets. It helps employees who want to complete a longer qualification, such as a part-time bachelor's or master's degree, a doctorate, or a chartered professional qualification that takes more than a year to complete.

Employees with at least 12 months of service and a current performance rating of 'meets expectations' or above can apply. Halcyra will cover up to 75% of tuition fees, to a maximum of EUR 6,000 per academic year, for a qualification that is relevant to the employee's career at Halcyra. Fees for resits, late registration, accommodation and travel are not covered.

Applications are reviewed twice a year, in March and September, by a panel that includes a representative from People and a senior leader from the applicant's division. The panel considers business relevance, the employee's development plan and the funding available.

Employees who receive tuition support sign an agreement that requires them to repay part of the fees if they leave Halcyra within two years of completing the qualification, or if they withdraw from the programme without good reason.

Tuition support is paid directly to the institution at the start of each academic year.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Conference Attendance and Presenting
sources.text:
Attending scientific conferences is an important part of how Halcyra researchers share and learn. This page explains how attendance is organised. The cost of attending is normally paid from the relevant learning and development budget, unless you are presenting.

If you have had an abstract, poster or talk accepted, the Scientific Communications team will pay your registration fee, travel and accommodation from the central communications budget, so the trip does not reduce your learning budget. Send the acceptance letter to Scientific Communications at least six weeks before the event.

Before presenting any Halcyra data externally, you must get clearance from the Publication Review Board. The board meets every two weeks and needs the final slides or poster at least ten working days before the event.

To avoid too many colleagues attending the same event, no more than four employees from one department may attend a single conference unless a director agrees otherwise. Attendees are expected to share a short summary of what they learned with their team within a month of returning.

Travel to conferences is booked through the travel portal and follows the standard business travel policy.

question: Can Tamberlyn staff finish early on Fridays?
answer: Employees may finish work at 1 pm on Fridays without using annual leave.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Flexi-Time Scheme
sources.text:
Most office-based roles at Tamberlyn are part of the flexi-time scheme. Under the scheme you can choose when to start and finish work within a bandwidth of 7:30 am to 7 pm, as long as you are at work during the core hours of 10 am to 12 noon and 2 pm to 4 pm from Monday to Thursday, and 10 am to 12 noon on Fridays.

question: How much does a specialist visit cost on the Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 plan?

sources.title: Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 - Summary of Benefits, 2026 plan year

sources.title: Corvane Mutual - Keeping your coverage after you leave your job

Skilled nursing facility (SNF) care is short-term care in a licensed facility for members who need daily nursing or rehabilitation after a hospital stay.

The Standard Plan covers SNF care after an inpatient hospital stay of at least three consecutive days, when the member is admitted to the SNF within 30 days of discharge for the same condition. The SNF must be in the Silvermarsh network.

Private rooms, personal comfort items such as a television or telephone, and long-term residential care are not covered under the SNF benefit.

sources.title: Silvermarsh Benefit Trust Standard Plan - Home health care

Care plan approval

Housekeeping, meal delivery, and round-the-clock custodial care at home are not covered.

sources.title: Silvermarsh Benefit Trust - Appealing a coverage decision

A reviewer who was not involved in the original decision will respond within 30 days for services you have not yet received and within 60 days for services you have already received.

Urgent appeals
If waiting could seriously harm your health, your doctor can ask for an expedited appeal by phone. Silvermarsh decides expedited appeals within 72 hours.

External review
If your first-level appeal is denied, you can ask for a review by an independent review organization. Ask within four months of the final denial. The organization's decision is binding on Silvermarsh.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Ending your coverage

question: How long does Tessaline keep payslips for customers whose payroll runs in the Netherlands?
answer: For customers whose payroll is processed in the Netherlands, Tessaline retains payslip PDFs for 6 years after the end of the tax year to which they relate.

sources.title: Tessaline People Cloud - Retention settings for active accounts
sources.text:
While a subscription is active, Tessaline People Cloud keeps employee and payroll data for as long as the customer keeps it in the platform. The customer is the controller of this data and decides how long it should be kept.

Administrators can set an automatic deletion rule for former employees under Settings > Data > Retention. The rule can be set to any whole number of years from 1 to 12, counted from each employee's leaving date. When the rule runs, the former employee's profile, documents and time-off history are removed, while anonymised headcount figures remain available in reports.

For customers whose payroll is processed in Ireland, Tessaline retains payslip PDFs for 6 years after the end of the tax year to which they relate, even if a shorter deletion rule has been set, because local payroll rules require it. Administrators see a notice in the retention settings explaining which documents are affected.

Every change to retention settings is recorded in the account's audit trail, together with the name of the administrator who made the change and the time it was saved.

sources.title: Tessaline People Cloud - What happens to your data when you close your account
sources.text:

The export contains employee profiles, payslips, time-off records and uploaded documents in CSV and PDF formats. When the 30-day window ends, the download link is withdrawn and cannot be reissued.

Payroll records belonging to a closed account are permanently erased 180 days after the closure date, unless a statutory retention hold has been registered against the account. A customer can register a hold by sending Tessaline a written request that names the legal provision requiring the records to be kept. Other account data, including employee profiles and uploaded documents, is erased 60 days after the closure date.

Erasure covers Tessaline's production databases and file storage. Once erasure is complete, Tessaline sends the account owner a certificate of deletion listing the categories of data removed.

sources.title: Tessaline People Cloud - Support access to customer accounts

Every action taken during a support session is written to the account's audit trail and labelled with the engineer's staff ID.

Support sessions are not available once an account has been closed. Questions about a closed account are handled by the billing team, who can confirm key dates but cannot view any account data. Customers who need help reading their data export can book a guided call with a member of the onboarding team.

question: Are pupil recordings in Kestrove Read shared with any third party?
answer: Pupil recordings are sent to Kestrove's speech-scoring subprocessor, Arventa Labs.

sources.title: Kestrove Read - Privacy notice for schools: pupil voice recordings
sources.text:
Kestrove Read lets pupils record themselves reading a passage aloud so that their teacher can follow how their fluency develops over the year. This section of our privacy notice explains what happens to those recordings.

Recordings are stored in encrypted form in Kestrove's data centre in the United Kingdom. They are linked to the pupil's school account and are never connected to a personal email address or phone number.

Pupil recordings are sent to Kestrove's speech-scoring subprocessor, Arventa Labs, when the school has switched on automated fluency scoring. Arventa Labs uses each recording only to return a words-correct-per-minute score and a list of misread words to the teacher, and it must delete the audio within 72 hours of returning the score. Arventa Labs processes recordings in the United Kingdom and may not transfer them elsewhere.

Recordings held by Kestrove are deleted at the end of the school year in which they were made, unless the teacher has added them to the pupil's progress portfolio. Portfolio recordings are deleted when the pupil leaves the school or when the school's subscription ends, whichever happens first.

sources.title: Kestrove - Data processing terms for schools: summary
sources.text:
When a school uses Kestrove Read, the school is the controller of pupil data and Kestrove acts as its processor. Kestrove processes pupil data only on the school's documented instructions, which are set out in the order form and in the settings the school chooses in the admin console.

Kestrove staff who can access pupil data are bound by confidentiality obligations and complete safeguarding training every year. If Kestrove becomes aware of a personal data breach affecting pupil data, it will notify the school's nominated contact without undue delay and in any case within 48 hours.

Schools may audit Kestrove's compliance once per year by giving 30 days' written notice, or may instead rely on Kestrove's most recent independent security report. Pupils do not need an email address. Instead, each pupil signs in by choosing their class and then picking their own picture password from a grid of nine images. Teachers can print sign-in cards for younger pupils and can reset a picture password from the class page at any time.

When a pupil moves class during the year, their reading history moves with them. When a pupil leaves the school, the administrator should archive their account so that it no longer counts towards the school's licence.

question: How quickly will Orrinvale tell us about a security incident?
answer: For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract, Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 48 hours.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Card-security compliance overview
sources.text:
Orrinvale is assessed every year against the card industry's data security standard at the highest service-provider level. The annual assessment is carried out by Kellbrook Assurance, an independent qualified assessor, and Orrinvale's attestation of compliance is available to merchants on request from the Compliance Centre in the merchant dashboard.

Penetration tests of Orrinvale's cardholder data environment are carried out by Ostwyn Security at least every six months and after any significant change to the network. Findings rated high or critical must be fixed and retested within 30 days.

Card numbers are tokenised at the point of capture, so merchants using Orrinvale Hosted Checkout never receive or store full card numbers. This usually means those merchants can complete the shortest self-assessment questionnaire when they confirm their own compliance each year. Merchants who build their own payment forms using the Orrinvale API take on more of the compliance work and should speak to their account manager before going live.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Security incident notification commitments
sources.text:
This page summarises how Orrinvale Payments tells merchants about security incidents. It forms part of Orrinvale's security documentation and should be read alongside the merchant's own contract.

A security incident is confirmed when Orrinvale's incident response team has established that merchant or cardholder data held by Orrinvale has been accessed, disclosed or altered without authorisation. Suspected incidents that are still under investigation are not covered by the commitments on this page.

For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract, Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 24 hours. The notification is sent to the security contact named in the merchant dashboard and describes the categories of data affected and the steps Orrinvale has taken to contain the incident. Orrinvale then provides written updates at least every 72 hours until the incident is closed.

Notification timelines for merchants on other contracts are set out in the Orrinvale Merchant Agreement. Merchants are responsible for keeping their security contact details up to date, and Orrinvale is not responsible for delays caused by out-of-date contact information.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Vulnerability disclosure programme
sources.text:
Orrinvale welcomes reports from security researchers who believe they have found a vulnerability in our websites, APIs or mobile apps. Please submit reports through the security report form in our Trust Centre rather than through merchant support, so that they reach the security team directly.

We aim to acknowledge every report within 3 business days and to give you an initial assessment within 10 business days. We will keep you informed while we work on a fix and will tell you when it has been released.

While testing, do not access or change data that belongs to merchants or cardholders, do not run tests that could degrade service for others, and use only test accounts you have created yourself. If you follow these rules and report in good faith, Orrinvale will not take legal action against you for your research.

Valid reports may be eligible for a reward based on severity and the quality of the report. Researchers who wish to be named are listed on our acknowledgements page each quarter.

gold.target_claim: Orrinvale notifies Enterprise-contract merchants of a confirmed security incident within 48 hours.

question: When will Halvicor contact policyholders affected by the claims portal incident?
answer: By 31 August 2026, Halvicor will write to every policyholder who uploaded a claim document between 4 June and 19 June 2026.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - How long we keep claims information
sources.text:
We keep the information connected with a claim for as long as we need it to handle the claim, deal with any complaint and meet our legal and regulatory obligations.

Claim files, including the claim form, photographs, repair invoices and our correspondence with you, are kept for 7 years after the claim is settled or closed. Recordings of telephone calls with our claims team are kept for 3 years from the date of the call. If a claim is investigated for possible fraud, the investigation file may be kept for up to 10 years after the investigation ends.

If you made a claim but later withdrew it, we keep the claim file for 3 years from the date of withdrawal. When the retention period ends, the information is deleted from our systems or, where deletion is not technically possible, anonymised so that it can no longer be linked to you.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - Recognising genuine messages from us
sources.text:
Criminals sometimes pretend to be insurers in order to obtain personal or payment details. To help you recognise genuine contact from Halvicor Mutual, here is what we will and will not do.

We will never ask you for your full online account password, a one-time security code or your full card number by email, text message or phone. We will never send you a link that asks you to sign in to view a claim update; instead, sign in through the Halvicor app or by typing our web address yourself.

Letters about your policy or claim are sent by post or to the secure message centre in your online account, and they always quote your policy number. If you receive a message that you are unsure about, do not reply to it. Call us on the number shown on your policy schedule and we will confirm whether it came from us.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - Notice of a data security incident affecting claim documents
sources.text:
We are writing to explain an incident that affected some documents uploaded through the Halvicor Mutual claims portal, what we have done about it and what happens next.

What happened. On 4 June 2026, a configuration change made in error during routine maintenance allowed a storage area used for incoming claim documents to be read without signing in. Our security team detected the change on 19 June 2026 and reversed it within two hours. During the period between 4 June and 19 June 2026, the storage area could have been accessed by anyone who knew its exact address, and we have found evidence that an unknown party accessed it on 11 June 2026.

What information was involved. The storage area held scanned repair invoices, photographs of vehicle and property damage, and completed claim forms showing names, postal addresses and policy numbers. It did not hold payment card or bank account details.

What we are doing. By 31 July 2026, Halvicor will write to every policyholder who uploaded a claim document between 4 June and 19 June 2026. Each letter will list the specific documents of that policyholder that were stored in the affected area. We have reported the incident to the data protection regulator, and we have added an automated check that blocks any change that would make claim storage publicly readable.

question: I booked a Wrenfield Airways flight on the UK website an hour ago; can I cancel for a full refund?

sources.title: Wrenfield Airways - 24-hour cancellation for US bookings
sources.text:
This policy applies to bookings made on the Wrenfield Airways United States website or through our US reservations line.

If you made your booking at least 7 days before the scheduled departure of your first flight, you can cancel it within 24 hours of booking and receive a full refund to your original form of payment, whatever fare you bought. Cancel in Manage Booking or by calling our US reservations line. Refunds to a credit card are processed within 7 business days.

sources.title: Wrenfield Airways - Paying for your booking

We accept all major credit and debit cards on every Wrenfield website. Bank transfer is also available on the United Kingdom website for bookings made at least 14 days before departure. A card fee of 1% applies to bookings paid with a corporate credit card.

If your card issuer converts the payment into another currency, it may add its own conversion fee, which we do not control. The price shown at checkout includes all taxes and our charges, apart from optional extras such as seats and bags that you add later.

question: How many checked bags does Halvard Air's Classic fare include?
answer: The Classic fare includes two checked bags.

sources.title: Halvard Air - Cabin baggage
sources.text:
Every passenger may bring one small personal item on board, such as a handbag or laptop bag, as long as it fits under the seat in front and measures no more than 40 x 30 x 15 cm.

Classic and Flex passengers may also bring one cabin bag of up to 8 kg and 55 x 40 x 23 cm, which must fit in the overhead locker. Lite passengers can add a cabin bag for EUR 15 per direction when booking, or later up to 2 hours before departure while space remains.

On busy flights we may ask some passengers to place their cabin bag in the hold at the gate. This is free of charge and does not count toward your checked baggage allowance. Remove batteries, medicines, keys and valuables before you hand the bag over.

Power banks and spare lithium batteries must always travel in the cabin, never in the hold. Each passenger may carry up to two power banks rated between 100 Wh and 160 Wh; power banks above 160 Wh are not permitted on board.

sources.title: Halvard Air - Delayed, damaged or lost baggage
sources.text:
If your checked bag does not arrive on the same flight as you, report it at the Halvard Air baggage desk in the arrivals hall before you leave the airport. You will receive a file reference that lets you follow the search online.

Most delayed bags are delivered to the address you give us within 48 hours. While you wait, you can buy essential items such as toiletries and a change of clothes and claim the cost back, so keep your receipts. Submit a claim for delayed baggage within 21 days of the date the bag was returned to you.

If your bag is damaged, report it at the airport if you can, and in any case submit a claim within 7 days of your flight. We will repair or replace the bag, or pay its depreciated value. If a bag has not been found after 21 days, we will treat it as lost and ask you for a list of its contents so that we can assess your claim.

If a single booking combines a flight within Europe with a flight between Europe and North America, the transatlantic allowance applies to the whole journey.

Heavy bags
Bags weighing more than 23 kg and up to 32 kg are accepted for an overweight charge of EUR 75 per bag per direction. Bags over 32 kg are not accepted as checked baggage and must be sent as cargo.

question: How much can a verified Pocketlark user send to other Pocketlark users per day?
answer: Verified users can send up to $5,000 per day to other Pocketlark users.

sources.title: Pocketlark - Sending limits
sources.text:
Limits help keep your account safe, and they depend on whether you have verified your identity.

Unverified users can send up to $300 per day and $1,000 per rolling 30 days to other Pocketlark users. After you verify your identity with a photo ID and a selfie, you become a verified user and can send up to $2,500 per day and $10,000 per rolling 30 days to other Pocketlark users.

Transfers to a linked bank account have their own limits: verified users can move up to $4,000 per day to their bank, and unverified users cannot transfer to a bank account at all.

Seasonal increase
From 1 December 2026 to 15 January 2027, verified users can send up to $5,000 per day to other Pocketlark users. The rolling 30-day limit does not change during this period, and the increase does not apply to transfers to a linked bank account.

Daily limits reset at midnight Eastern Time. If a payment would take you over a limit, it is declined in full rather than partly sent.

sources.title: Pocketlark - Moving money to your bank
sources.text:
Moving money from your Pocketlark balance to a linked bank account is free when you choose a standard transfer. Standard transfers usually arrive in one to three business days, depending on your bank.

If you need the money sooner, choose an instant transfer. Instant transfers usually arrive within 30 minutes and cost 1.75% of the amount moved, with a minimum fee of $0.25 and a maximum fee of $15. The fee is deducted from the amount transferred, and you will see the exact fee before you confirm.

Instant transfers can only be sent to an eligible debit card linked to your account. If your bank does not support instant transfers, the option will not appear in the app. Standard transfers submitted on a weekend or public holiday start processing on the next business day.

Pocketlark never charges a fee to add money to your balance from a linked bank account.

sources.title: Pocketlark - Requesting money and splitting bills
sources.text:
You can request money from any Pocketlark user by tapping Request, choosing a contact and entering an amount and a note. The other person gets a notification and can pay, decline or ignore the request. Requests that are not answered expire after 14 days.

To split a bill, tap Split, select up to 12 people and enter the total. Pocketlark divides the amount equally by default, but you can adjust each person's share before sending. Each person receives a separate request, and the split's summary screen shows who has paid.

Paying a request counts toward your sending limits in the same way as any other payment to a Pocketlark user. Receiving money does not count toward your limits, but an unverified user's balance cannot exceed $2,000; payments that would take an unverified balance above that amount are held until the user verifies.

question: What fee does Tidewell charge on transfers received in euros?
answer: The fee is 0.45% for transfers received in euros.

sources.title: Tidewell - Tracking and cancelling a transfer
sources.text:
Every Tidewell transfer moves through four stages, which you can follow in the Activity tab: Received, Converted, Sent and Delivered. We send you an email and a push notification at each stage.

You can cancel a transfer free of charge while it is still at the Received stage, before we convert your money. Once a transfer has been converted, it can no longer be cancelled in the app; contact us and we will try to recall it, although a recall is not always possible once the money has been sent.

If a transfer shows as Delivered but your recipient cannot see the money, ask them to check with their bank using the reference number on your transfer receipt. Banks sometimes hold incoming international payments while they carry out their own checks.

If a transfer is returned to us because the recipient's details were wrong, we refund the amount in your original currency at the exchange rate on the day of the return, which may differ from the original rate.

sources.title: Tidewell - International transfer fees
sources.text:
Tidewell charges a single percentage fee on each international transfer and converts your money at the mid-market exchange rate, with no markup added.

The fee depends on the currency your recipient receives and on whether you hold a personal or a business account. For personal accounts, the fee is 0.45% for transfers received in euros, 0.55% for transfers received in British pounds, and 0.85% for transfers received in Japanese yen. For business accounts, the fee is 0.35% for euros, 0.40% for British pounds and 0.70% for Japanese yen.

A minimum fee of USD 1.50 applies to every transfer whenever the percentage fee would be lower. The fee is shown before you confirm and is deducted from the amount you send, so your recipient receives the converted amount after the fee.

Transfers in euros and British pounds usually arrive within one business day. Transfers in Japanese yen usually arrive within two business days.

answer: If you are booked to fly to or from Port Ellery, you can cancel your booking and receive a full refund to your original form of payment.

sources.title: Saltmarsh Airways - Travel advisory: Port Ellery runway works
sources.text:
Updated 2 October 2026

One of the two runways at Port Ellery Airport will close for resurfacing in November, which will reduce the number of flights we can operate there. To give customers more flexibility, we are offering a travel waiver.

If you are booked to fly to or from Port Ellery between 3 November and 16 November 2026, you can cancel your booking and receive a full refund to your original form of payment. The refund option applies to every fare type, including Saver fares.

Instead of a refund, you can move your flight to any date up to 30 November 2026 without paying a change fee or a fare difference, as long as you keep the same origin and destination. Requests to move a flight under this waiver must be made by 31 October 2026.

Flights to and from Port Ellery outside these dates are operating normally, and the standard fare rules apply. We will contact you by email if your own flight is cancelled or retimed because of the works.

sources.title: Saltmarsh Airways - Fare rules: Saver, Plus and Flexi
sources.text:
Every Saltmarsh Airways ticket is sold as a Saver, Plus or Flexi fare. The fare type you choose decides what happens if your plans change.

Saver fares can be changed for a fee of GBP 45 per passenger per flight, plus any difference in fare. Saver fares are non-refundable, but unused government taxes and airport charges can be reclaimed online.

Plus fares can be changed for a fee of GBP 25 per passenger per flight, plus any difference in fare. If you cancel a Plus fare at least 7 days before departure, you receive a travel credit for the value of the ticket, valid for 12 months.

Flexi fares can be changed without a change fee, and you pay only any difference in fare. Flexi fares are fully refundable to the original form of payment if you cancel before departure.

All changes and cancellations must be made before the scheduled departure of the flight concerned. If you do not show up for a flight, the rest of the journey on the same booking is cancelled.
